name: Jessy Jose
summary: Dr. Jessy Jose is an Associate Professor in the Department of Physics at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Tirupati, where she serves as the Principal Investigator of the Star and Planet Formation Group (SFG@IISERT)
researchInterests: Her research focuses on star formation in low-metallicity environments, protoplanetary disk evolution, the demographics of brown dwarfs and free-floating planetary mass objects, and studies of the Initial Mass Function. She has experience with many international observing facilities such as JWST, VLT, LBT, Subaru, Spitzer, CFHT ,HST etc.
